Name: Skitter Crab
FlavorText: Small, fast, and everywhere at once. One hit is all it takes — the trick is landing it before it lands on you.

Name: Pincer Runt
FlavorText: Too young to have grown a proper shell. It makes up for it by swarming in packs.

Name: Shell Grub
FlavorText: Barely more than a larva with legs, but it still bites like it means it.

Name: Sand Scuttler
FlavorText: Kicks up a cloud with every scramble across the dunes — half the fight is just seeing it coming.

Name: Reef Nipper
FlavorText: Darts between cover along the reef line, snapping at anything that gets close.

Name: Claw Scrapper
FlavorText: Drags one oversized claw everywhere it goes. Slow to aim, quick to swing.

Name: Barnacle Biter
FlavorText: Clings to whatever's nearest — wreckage, coral, you — and doesn't let go easily.

Name: Husk Crawler
FlavorText: Wears the cracked shell of something bigger that didn't make it. Doesn't slow it down any.

Name: Tide Snapper
FlavorText: Rides in on the surf and strikes the moment the water pulls back.
